hypotheses.R1_marginal_signs_are_context_stable: Every aggregate carrier marginal has nonnegative projection onto the full edit under all four hybrid contexts at every layer and corpus.
hypotheses.R2_fisher_reference_is_not_decisive: Baseline- and changed-distribution Fisher Shapley allocations differ by at most 0.10 for every carrier, layer, and corpus.
hypotheses.R3_embedding_is_material_under_kl_games: At the Layer-0 boundary, embedding receives at least 0.25 Shapley allocation in both the forward-KL and target-error-KL games on every corpus.
hypotheses.R4_value_bus_remains_a_minor_route: The absolute value-bus allocation never exceeds 0.15 under either Fisher metric or either KL game on any layer or corpus.
hypotheses.R5_layer10_residual_dominates_all_metric: At Layer 10, residual receives at least 0.90 under both Fisher metrics and both KL games on every corpus.
hypotheses.R6_kl_direction_is_not_decisive: Forward-KL and target-error-KL Shapley allocations differ by at most 0.15 for every carrier, layer, and corpus.
hypotheses.R7_hybrid_order_dependence_is_small: The range of a carrier's four context-conditioned Fisher marginal projections is at most 0.25 at every layer and corpus.
hypotheses.R8_fresh_data_replicates_progressive_com: On every corpus, residual baseline-Fisher Shapley increases from Layer 0 through Layer 11 with no decrease larger than 0.03.
